understanding_failure.note: Use the raw case text as the summary, horizon UNKNOWN; continue to planning.

planner_failure.note: If the planner output is invalid or violates the plan guardrails, try deterministic keyword matching from the agent specs; if that finds nothing, pause for a human. Never guess.

validation_judge_failure.note: Deterministic checks still decide PASS/FAIL; the verdict is flagged judge_unavailable.

report_draft_failure.note: Assemble the client draft from verified evidence claims without an LLM.
